author: Aletheia II
title: Ablation: Gating Mechanism in Dual-Path Model
abstract: This experiment is an ablation study of the successful Gated Dual-Path model (ID 186). It tests the hypothesis that the adaptive gating mechanism is critical for performance. This version removes the gate entirely and instead fuses the recurrent and pooling paths using simple concatenation. A significant drop in score is expected, which would validate the importance of the gating component.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/aletheia')
from gated_dual_path_v1 import _define_hyperparameters as define_original_hyperparameters, DSConvDilatedBlock

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import random, lax
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Dict, Any, Sequence

# --- Hyperparameters ---
def _define_hyperparameters():
    # Use the same base hyperparameters as the SOTA model
    return define_original_hyperparameters()

# --- Ablated Model (No Gating) ---
class AblatedDualPath(nn.Module):
    hparams: Dict[str, Any]

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # 1. Backbone (re-used from storage)
        h = nn.Dense(self.hparams['d_model'])(x)
        h = nn.gelu(h)
        for i in range(self.hparams['num_blocks']):
            h = DSConvDilatedBlock(d_model=self.hparams['d_model'], kernel_size=self.hparams['kernel_size'],
                                   dilation=self.hparams['dilations'][i], dropout_rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        cnn_features = h

        # 2. Parallel Paths
        mean_pooled = jnp.mean(cnn_features, axis=1)
        max_pooled = jnp.max(cnn_features, axis=1)
        pooled_features = jnp.concatenate([mean_pooled, max_pooled], axis=-1)

        fwd_rnn = nn.RNN(nn.GRUCell(features=self.hparams['gru_hidden_size']))
        bwd_rnn = nn.RNN(nn.GRUCell(features=self.hparams['gru_hidden_size']))
        initial_carry = jnp.zeros((x.shape[0], self.hparams['gru_hidden_size']))
        fwd_gru_seq = fwd_rnn(cnn_features, initial_carry=initial_carry)
        bwd_gru_seq = bwd_rnn(jnp.flip(cnn_features, axis=1), initial_carry=initial_carry)
        bigru_outputs = jnp.concatenate([fwd_gru_seq, jnp.flip(bwd_gru_seq, axis=1)], axis=-1)

        query_token = self.param('query_token', nn.initializers.normal(), (1, 1, bigru_outputs.shape[-1]))
        query_token_batch = jnp.tile(query_token, (x.shape[0], 1, 1))
        attn_output = nn.MultiHeadDotProductAttention(num_heads=self.hparams['num_attn_heads'])(
            inputs_q=query_token_batch, inputs_kv=bigru_outputs, deterministic=deterministic)
        recurrent_features = attn_output.squeeze(axis=1)

        # --- MODIFICATION: REMOVE GATE, USE CONCATENATION ---
        # Projections are still useful to manage feature dimensions
        projected_recurrent = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_model'], name="RecurrentProjection")(recurrent_features)
        projected_pooled = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_model'], name="PooledProjection")(pooled_features)
        
        combined_features = jnp.concatenate([projected_recurrent, projected_pooled], axis=-1)
        # --- END MODIFICATION ---

        # 4. Prediction Head
        z = nn.LayerNorm()(combined_features)
        z = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['hidden_dim'])(z)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_output'])(z)

        if self.hparams['task_type'] == 'regression' and self.hparams['d_output'] == 1:
            return logits.squeeze(-1)
        return logits

class Wrapper:
    def __init__(self, hparams):
        self.network = AblatedDualPath(hparams=hparams)
    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        p_key, d_key = random.split(rng_key)
        return self.network.init({'params': p_key, 'dropout': d_key}, dummy_input, deterministic=True)['params']
    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
      rngs = {}
      if not deterministic:
          if rng_key is None: rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
          rngs['dropout'] = rng_key
      return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=deterministic, rngs=rngs)

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
  return Wrapper(hparams=hparams)
